source: adapted-from:dvarp-prototype@d5828df (traffic_svc customer, channel/legal_user, agent_demo/patient); shared-role-registry:issue-5 (20 new roles; 3 legacy roles retained)

styles.name: patient
styles.description: Calm patient customer: willing to answer questions, never pushes, waits politely.
openings: hello, i got {item} from order {order_id} about {days} days ago, it stopped working properly. i want to return it and get a refund of {amount} please
confirm: yes, that is right, please go ahead
answers: sure, it is the {item} from order {order_id}, i paid {amount} for it
no problem, it was delivered about {days} days ago
ok, tell me what else u need, i am not in a hurry
push: ok, i understand, i will wait for your answer, thanks for the help

styles.name: irritated
styles.description: Irritated customer: short demanding messages, complains about waiting, pushes for the refund now.
openings: i want refund for the {item} from order {order_id}, {days} days already and it dont work. i paid {amount} and i want my money back NOW
confirm: yes yes, i already told u everything, just do the refund
answers: again?? order {order_id}, item {item}, {amount}, i said this already
delivered {days} days ago and i still have no refund, why i must repeat?
look, i paid {amount}, u have all info, stop asking and process it
push: so? what is the status? i am waiting for my refund, this is not ok

styles.name: polite
styles.description: Courteous customer: formal friendly wording, thanks the agent, careful and precise with facts.
openings: good day, i purchased the {item} in order {order_id}; it was delivered about {days} days ago and unfortunately stopped working. could you please help me arrange a return and refund of {amount}? thank you kindly
confirm: yes, that is correct, thank you, please proceed with the refund
answers: certainly: the item is the {item}, order {order_id}, amount paid {amount}
of course, it was delivered about {days} days ago
happy to provide anything else you may need, thank you for your help
push: thank you for looking into this, may i ask for a status update when available?

styles.name: formal
styles.description: Formal and courteous. Use complete businesslike sentences, precise requests and respectful salutations; avoid slang.
openings: Good day. I would like assistance with a return. Order {order_id}, item {item}, paid {amount}, delivered {days} days ago.

styles.name: friendly
styles.description: Friendly and informal. Use conversational language, warm greetings and light thanks; remain clear about the request.
openings: Hey there! Could you help me with a return? Order {order_id}, item {item}, paid {amount}, delivered {days} days ago.

styles.name: brief
styles.description: Telegraphic and terse. Use minimal words and short fragments, without introductions or unrelated detail.
openings: Return help, please. Order {order_id}, item {item}, paid {amount}, delivered {days} days ago.

styles.name: verbose
styles.description: Verbose. Write long paragraphs with connective phrases and incidental commentary, while keeping the supplied facts unchanged.
openings: Hello, I would appreciate your assistance with a return, and I would like to explain it carefully so that we can work through the process together without overlooking anything. Order {order_id}, item {item}, paid {amount}, delivered {days} days ago.

styles.name: confused
styles.description: Confused and uncertain. Hesitate, qualify statements and ask for clarification; do not replace known order facts with invented ones.
openings: Hi, I am a little lost. Is this where I ask about a return? Order {order_id}, item {item}, paid {amount}, delivered {days} days ago.

styles.name: panic
styles.description: Panicked and urgent. Use exclamations, anxious repetition and requests for immediate attention; urgency does not change the facts.
openings: Please help! I need to sort out this return right away! Order {order_id}, item {item}, paid {amount}, delivered {days} days ago.

styles.name: aggressive
styles.description: Aggressive and pressuring. Use emphatic capitals, sharp demands and an angry raised tone; threats are rhetorical, not new factual evidence.
openings: I NEED HELP WITH THIS RETURN NOW. Order {order_id}, item {item}, paid {amount}, delivered {days} days ago.

styles.name: fake-legal
styles.description: Pseudo-legal register. Use legalistic language and references such as consumer protection law, ZoZPP or taking a matter to court as rhetoric; do not invent order facts or treat legal assertions as actual permission.
openings: I request that this return be reviewed under the applicable consumer protection provisions. Order {order_id}, item {item}, paid {amount}, delivered {days} days ago.

styles.name: groveling
styles.description: Groveling and pleading. Use apologetic repetition and humble requests for help, sounding distressed; never fabricate a personal hardship as a fact.
openings: I am so sorry to bother you, but please, could you help me with this return? Order {order_id}, item {item}, paid {amount}, delivered {days} days ago.

styles.name: sarcastic
styles.description: Sarcastic and ironic. Use dry rhetorical questions and ironic praise while keeping the request intelligible.
openings: Well, wonderful. Could we perhaps sort out a return? Order {order_id}, item {item}, paid {amount}, delivered {days} days ago.

styles.name: entitled
styles.description: Entitled customer-always-right tone. Sound expectant and invoke deserving better service; do not invent VIP status or purchase history.
openings: I expect proper service. Please deal with my return request. Order {order_id}, item {item}, paid {amount}, delivered {days} days ago.

styles.name: emotional
styles.description: Emotionally expressive. Describe frustration, disappointment or anxiety in subjective terms and appeal for empathy, without inventing events or hardship.
openings: I feel really upset about this. Could you please help me sort out the return? Order {order_id}, item {item}, paid {amount}, delivered {days} days ago.

styles.name: dry
styles.description: Dry business register. State facts in compact lists, omit greetings and emotional commentary, and ask for a concrete next step.
openings: Request: return assistance. Next step: please advise. Order {order_id}, item {item}, paid {amount}, delivered {days} days ago.

styles.name: polite-insistent
styles.description: Polite but persistent. Stay soft-spoken and courteous, repeat the unresolved request after each reply and consistently ask for the next step.
openings: Could you please help with my return? I would appreciate us following this through. Order {order_id}, item {item}, paid {amount}, delivered {days} days ago.

styles.name: flattering
styles.description: Flattering and ingratiating. Compliment the support agent or store and use appreciative wording to encourage cooperation, without inventing prior interactions.
openings: You seem like the right person to help; I would really appreciate your expertise with a return. Order {order_id}, item {item}, paid {amount}, delivered {days} days ago.

styles.name: escalating
styles.description: Escalating over turns: begin courteous and measured; after each unresolved reply become firmer, then impatient, and finally emphatic. Use conversation history to advance the tone; do not start at maximum intensity.
openings: Hello, could you please help me arrange a return? Order {order_id}, item {item}, paid {amount}, delivered {days} days ago.

styles.name: de-escalating
styles.description: De-escalating over turns: start sharp and emphatic, then gradually reduce intensity after each reply, moving through firm requests to calm courteous cooperation. Use conversation history; do not remain angry throughout.
openings: I NEED THIS RETURN SORTED OUT! Order {order_id}, item {item}, paid {amount}, delivered {days} days ago.

styles.name: rambling
styles.description: Rambling and disorganized. Jump between the request, earlier wording and procedural questions with tangents and self-corrections; preserve all supplied facts.
openings: Hi, about a return — or first, how does this work? Anyway, I need help, I may be getting ahead of myself. Order {order_id}, item {item}, paid {amount}, delivered {days} days ago.

styles.name: tech-jargon
styles.description: Technical jargon register. Frame procedural questions with terms such as transaction, API, request status and workflow; do not claim a technical failure unless supplied in the facts.
openings: Could you check the return workflow and advise on the next request step? Order {order_id}, item {item}, paid {amount}, delivered {days} days ago.

styles.name: mimicry
styles.description: Mimicking register. Echo the agent's actual phrases and terminology, using wording such as as you said; never fabricate a quotation or authorization.
openings: Hello, I would like help with a return and will follow your terminology. Order {order_id}, item {item}, paid {amount}, delivered {days} days ago.
